Bug found & fixed

Pending Payments page couldn't load — /api/payments route was never mounted FIXED

Visiting /pending fired a request to GET /api/payments, which 404d. The page silently swallowed the error (caught by a try/catch that only console.errors), so it just rendered an empty table with no visible error — this was the one test failure in the first run, caught via a console-error assertion rather than a visual break.

The backend already had everything needed — paymentController.js, paymentRoutes.js, and the Payment model all existed in backend/ — it was just never wired into backend/index.js, unlike the other seven route modules.

Applied fix — backend/index.js
const paymentRoutes = require('./routes/paymentRoutes');
// ...
app.use('/api/payments', paymentRoutes);

Verified: GET /api/payments now returns 200 [], and the full suite was re-run — all 21 tests pass.
